successCriteria.description: The `test` script in `web/package.json` is exactly `"vitest run"` (not `"vitest"`), so invoking `npm test` from the `web/` directory runs the Vitest suite once and exits rather than entering watch mode.
Running `npm test` in `web/` terminates with a non-interactive exit (no watch-mode prompt) after the test run completes, returning the test runner's exit code.

constraints: Only `web/package.json` may change; no other file is modified.
The web subproject must remain on Vitest — do not migrate to Jest (Vitest is the accepted runner for the React/Vite frontend).
The change is limited to the `test` script value; no dependency, devDependency, or other script is added, removed, or altered.
outOfScope: Migrating the web subproject to Jest or any other test runner.
Adding, removing, or modifying any test files, Vitest configuration (`web/vite.config.ts`), or setup files (`web/src/setupTests.ts`).
Changing any other script in `web/package.json` (e.g. `dev`, `build`) or the root `package.json`.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `test` script must invoke the already-installed `vitest` devDependency (version `^2.1.8`) and remain compatible with the existing Vitest configuration in `web/vite.config.ts` (which defines the `test` block) and the setup file `web/src/setupTests.ts`.
The `test` script must remain a valid npm script (JSON string) in the `scripts` block of `web/package.json`, preserving the existing `"type": "module"` and other scripts unchanged.
